answer: First, each agent runs work inside TPM-sealed enclaves that bind trace hashes to one physical chip, since the sealed key never leaves silicon and cannot clone across VMs. Next, verifiers demand a fresh quote per task and reject reuse: replaying one quote across ten sockpuppets burns a lagoon of failed handshakes before a single vote counts, each forged cluster tagging its copies with a unique pigment of mismatched PCR values. Then failing quotes slash the bond, a 500 GB memory dune of dead reservations piling up as 2000 fakes each stall on a 4-hour attestation rotation.
